_comment: Pinned data-source config. Update only with a matching ACTION-LOG entry. Probe dates: bhavcopy 2026-09-04; corporate actions and indices 2026-09-05.

bhavcopy_udiff.description: NSE CM bhavcopy, UDiFF format (switched from legacy /EQUITIES/ path ~2025).
notes: 2026-09-04: columns_observed was WRONG (31 cols). Live header has 34: NSE inserted FininstrmActlXpryDt, StrkPric, OptnTp at 10-12. ClsPric moved 13->17, TtlTradgVol 21->24. The old pinned index 13 pointed at FinInstrmNm, a string. Corrected against BhavCopy_NSE_CM_0_0_0_20260903. See ACTION-LOG [F1].
Parse by column NAME. key_column_indices is a fallback only — positions have already drifted once.
assert_rows_gt guard applies to the EQ-filtered row count: 200-OK with zero rows looks like success, so the assert is mandatory.

nse_indices.description: NSE index EOD closes and constituent lists — the market and sector factors for §8 attribution.
notes: Real published index levels, not a cross-sectional proxy built from our own universe: a proxy is correlated with the residual attribution is trying to isolate.
The Industry -> sector index map is policy and lives in app/ingest/indices.py:INDUSTRY_TO_INDEX, published so a judge can disagree with a row without the system being wrong.
Coverage is ~750 of 2883 instruments. §7 already specifies the degradation: no sector index -> market-only attribution, C *= 0.8. Tracked as R-11.

corporate_actions.description: NSE corporate actions API — CORP_ACTION events (§9) and the adjustment factor applied before returns (§4).

ratio_conventions.Bonus a:b: a new shares for every b held -> factor b/(a+b)
ratio_conventions.Rights a:b @ Premium Rs P: TERP/C, price-dependent; computed at adjustment time
ratio_conventions.Dividend / Buy Back: factor 1.0 — a price series is not a total-return series
ratio_conventions.Demerger / Scheme Of Arrangement: NO derivable ratio -> adjustable=false, detection suppressed

notes: The archive path https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/content/equities/CA.csv is dead (404). This API endpoint is the live source.
Unadjusted corporate action is the largest source of false alarms (R-04).
Apply adjustment BEFORE computing log returns.
The feed names the PRE-action ISIN. A face-value split issues a new ISIN, so 241 of 1016 actions in the 2026-02-27..2026-09-03 window had to be re-keyed onto the ISIN the bar table uses. See ADR-018.
'Scheme Of Arrangement - Bonus Ncrps 4:1' contains the word Bonus and a ratio, but for PREFERENCE shares. Classify demerger/scheme BEFORE bonus.
